newsitem.title: USA: Talks at Phelps's Chino mine resume Friday.
newsitem.headline: Talks at Phelps's Chino mine resume Friday.

text.p: Labor talks at Phelps Dodge's Chino mine resume Friday, as previously announced, in a bid to end the stalemate which has dogged negotiations since the last contract expired June 30.
Phelps spokeswoman Sue Suver said one day of talks are scheduled, starting at 0900 MST/1600 GMT in Las Cruces, N.M., where Chino is located.
Phelps has repeatedly said the offer it presented late August to unions, led by the United Steelworkers of America, was its final one.

USWA officials have said they were unhappy with the offer which called for a pay freeze, especially after facilities at ASARCO and, lately, Kennecott Utah Copper Corp, settled for a new deal which included a pay hike.
USWA officials were not immediately available for comment.
Chino produces about 170,000 tonnes of contained copper a year.
